newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 11.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac said at cabinet meeting today France is launching a call to the international community to put an end to fighting in Zaire and allow for aid intervention.
-- European Renault workers to demonstrate in Paris area today against planned plant shut-down and restructuring.

-- Government names Bull executive Thierry Breton head of Thomson Multimedia (TMM) and Thomson SA, will lead privatisation process of Thomson Multimedia. Marcel Roulet to lead privatisation of Thomson-CSF.
-- Prime Minister's office decides to launch controversial process depriving nickel-mining group Eramet of some of its mining rights in New Caledonia, as announced on February 24.
-- Daewoo Electronics Co to open plant manufacturing television components at Thionville in eastern France, an investment estimated at 1.8 billion francs.
-- Renault European group committee meeting to be held today. Analysts expect topics to include need to diversify alliances, emphasis on international activity to regain competitiveness.
-- Rhone-Poulenc to close plastics plant in Belgium from April 30 because of persistent losses.
